name: probe-sub-finally
code:
log=[]
def sub():
    try:
        yield 1
    except ValueError:
        log.append('caught')
        yield 2
    finally:
        log.append('finally')
it=sub()
next(it)
print(it.throw(ValueError('boom')))
try:
 next(it)
except StopIteration:
 log.append('done')
print(log)
